computed.description:
A closed Spin^c period on T^2 x CP^2, in the fixed explicit cochain coordinate.

n2 = 2 A, omega2 = rho2 B, s1=0, n3=0,
n4 = rho2((B-lift omega2)/2) cup rho2 A.
A is the product of the two degree-one circle cocycles.  B^2 pairs to 1
on the fixed three-simplex K(Z,2) four-cycle.  All 90 product six-simplices
are evaluated, with no symmetry-group fit and no suspended phase callback.
The external physical comparison is the complex Spin^c Dirac index, not
an assertion that the nonzero ordinary cochain period is an obstruction
to a continuous-symmetry field theory.

description: All 90 signed simplices of T^2 x CP^2 give ordinary cochain period 1/8. The stored gauge and gravitational integrals are each 1/8; the index subtracts the gravitational term, giving +1/8 - 1/8 = 0. This is a geometric normalization check, not a continuous-symmetry obstruction claim.
